slides.title: Cover
slides.transcript: Susu the Cat. A true story, for Yusuf. This is the story of our cat, and the family that grew around her.

slides.title: Oklahoma
slides.transcript: Oklahoma. Baba Hisham was studying far from home, where the winters are long and white. One cold day he came back carrying a small striped kitten with four white paws. Her name was Susu.

slides.title: Two
slides.transcript: The two of them. Susu sat on his papers while he worked, and slept by his feet when the nights ran long. Just the two of them.

slides.title: Road
slides.transcript: The long road. Then the books went into boxes, and Susu went into her soft carrier, and the road went on, and on, and on. Where are we going, Baba?

slides.title: California
slides.transcript: California. A new home, with a wide sunny window. Susu found the warmest spot in it before the boxes were even open. This will do nicely.

slides.title: Mama
slides.transcript: Mama came. Then Mama came, and the house grew warmer and fuller. Susu sniffed her hand once, thought about it, and decided she was family. Now we are three.

slides.title: Yusuf
slides.transcript: And then Yusuf. Then a very small baby came home. Susu crept close, sniffed his toes, and lay down near him to keep watch. Now we are four.

slides.title: Days
slides.transcript: Susu's days. The sunny window in the morning. Baba's lap in the evening. Mama's kitchen whenever something smells good. And a baby to watch over, all day long. A very happy cat.

slides.title: Kindness
slides.transcript: Be kind to cats. Our Prophet, peace be upon him, taught us to be gentle with every animal. He told of a woman who shut a cat away, and gave her no food and no water, and would not let her go and find her own. And it counted against her. So Susu's bowls are never empty.

slides.title: Goodnight
slides.transcript: Goodnight, Susu. Goodnight Baba. Goodnight Mama. Goodnight Susu, curled up at the end of the bed. Goodnight, Yusuf.
